subject: pri-af-td
title: PRI.AF.TD.------ACC.DY.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-19, paired with v1-p115-1. (C)PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies) is crossed with ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics): the question is what acceleration of dynamics does to primary affinity tendencies — Braxton's term for the foundational tendencies that pre-organize how a culture orients to its essence. PRI-AF-TO is fed by C-INFO (composite information) and AF-CON (affinity convergence). PRI-AF-TO outputs to ACC-DY directly, and into INFO-OR (information order), which then fans into four chains: → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle); → MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) → MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and MT-INTR → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance); → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → POL-DYM (political dynamics). The structural argument: when affinity tendencies are accelerated, the resulting information order does not flow whole — it diversifies into four distinct downstream chains (dynamic functionalism→world expansion, multiple interpretation→diversification, multiple interpretation→progressional continuance, physical-universe→political dynamics). Read against the section's argument: the source-transfer dynamics imposed on black culture *accelerated* primary affinity tendencies in ways that fragmented their downstream coherence, producing the multiple-interpretation/diversification spread Braxton names as both vital and structurally constraining.
